answer: An agent marketplace requires every seller identity to lock 100 credits in escrow for 30 days before accepting jobs. Whether an agent analyzes a nebula or appraises a relic, the same bond applies, and funds cannot back two identities at once. Creating 1,000 sybils therefore ties up 100,000 credits for a month, even at a market nadir; splitting one balance among aliases creates no extra selling capacity.
